animate.reason: Op "animate" changes a permanent's basic kind (CR 205.1a/611.1) — covered by the Op's own interpreter + wire-format tests

attach.reason: Op "attach" targets a creature the CONTROLLER controls — not modelable by the generator's opponent-battlefield target placement

becomeCopy.reason: Op "becomeCopy" copies one runtime permanent onto another (identical canned fillers, phase-boundary revert) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

becomeMonarch.reason: Op "becomeMonarch" sets the global monarch designation — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

captureBinding.reason: Op "captureBinding" spans two separate resolutions of the same source's abilities — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

cascade.reason: Op "cascade" needs its own spell on the stack for the CR 702.85a threshold and suspends for a live Cast/Decline — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

castDuringResolution.reason: Op "castDuringResolution" suspends for a live Cast/Decline + the played card's own picks (CR 608.2g) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

choice.reason: Op "choice" suspends for player input — covered by the Op's own suspension/resume tests

chooseCategorized.reason: Op "chooseCategorized" suspends for a choose-categorized pick — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

chooseCreatureType.reason: Op "chooseCreatureType" suspends for a live creature-type choice (CR 205.3m) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

chooseNumber.reason: Op "chooseNumber" suspends for a numeric nomination — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

coinFlip.reason: Op "coinFlip" draws a random bit and suspends for the reveal (CR 705) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

coinFlipSeries.reason: Op "coinFlipSeries" draws random bits (CR 705) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

coinFlipSync.reason: Op "coinFlipSync" draws a random bit (CR 705) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

counter.reason: Op "counter" targets a spell on the stack — covered by the card's own resolution test

createTokenCopy.reason: Op "createTokenCopy" copies a runtime source permanent (announced target / ref) the canned generator does not model — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

dealDamageDividedAsChosen.reason: dealDamageDividedAsChosen — announced multi-target division cannot be scenario-ized

delayedTrigger.reason: Op "delayedTrigger" fires at a future phase boundary — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

digMatchingToHand.reason: Op "digMatchingToHand" depends on a filter match against library contents — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

discard.reason: Op "discard" consumes a choice binding, a hand filter, or discards the whole hand — covered by the card's own suspension/resume or per-card test

discardAtRandom.reason: Op "discardAtRandom" picks the discarded cards at random (seeded PRNG) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

divideIntoPiles.reason: Op "divideIntoPiles" suspends for two DIFFERENT players' picks (ADR 0053) — covered by hand-written per-card tests

exileAndReturnTransformed.reason: Op "exileAndReturnTransformed" swaps a permanent's printed characteristic set across a CR 400.7 zone change — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

exileSelf.reason: Op "exileSelf" redirects the resolving spell's own destination to exile — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

exileTopOfLibrary.reason: Op "exileTopOfLibrary" moves top-of-library cards to exile — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

exileWithAttachments.reason: Op "exileWithAttachments" arms an exile-and-return bundle whose observable outcome needs a later source-leaves/untaps return — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

explore.reason: Op "explore" reveals an unprovisionable top card and suspends on the nonland branch's keep-or-bin choice — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

extraCombat.reason: Op "extraCombat" mutates a turn-structure queue, not a same-step outcome — covered by hand-written tests

extraTurn.reason: Op "extraTurn" mutates a turn-boundary queue, not a same-step outcome — covered by hand-written tests

forEach.reason: construct "forEach" iterates a runtime-selected set — covered by the card's own tests

gainControl.reason: Op "gainControl" changes control of a permanent (and installs a conditional-control SBA) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

grantCastFromExile.reason: Op "grantCastFromExile" consumes a choice binding — covered by the card's own suspension/resume tests

grantCastFromGraveyard.reason: Op "grantCastFromGraveyard" grants a cast permission off a choice binding or a graveyard target — covered by the card's own tests

hideaway.reason: Op "hideaway" suspends for a look-distribute pick and exiles face down — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

if.reason: construct "if" branches on a runtime predicate — covered by the construct's interpreter tests

libraryLook.reason: Op "libraryLook" shuffles a library (seeded-PRNG randomization) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

lookDistribute.reason: Op "lookDistribute" suspends for a look-distribute pick — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

lookHand.reason: Op "lookHand" changes card visibility (knownTo) — not a state change the canned generator asserts

lookRandomHand.reason: Op "lookRandomHand" changes card visibility (knownTo) — not a state change the canned generator asserts

loseAllAbilities.reason: Op "loseAllAbilities" strips abilities (CR 613.1f) — the canned filler has none, so it is covered by the Op's own interpreter + wire-format tests

loseAllAbilitiesWhileSourceRemains.reason: Op "loseAllAbilitiesWhileSourceRemains" strips abilities (CR 613.1f) for a source-tied duration — covered by the Op's own interpreter + wire-format tests

mayPay.reason: Op "mayPay" suspends for a Pay/Skip decision — covered by the Op's own suspension/resume tests

mill.reason: Op "mill" moves top-of-library cards to the graveyard — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

moveSpellFromStack.reason: Op "moveSpellFromStack" targets a spell on the stack — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

moveZone.reason: Op "moveZone" changes zones on an object/zone the canned generator does not model — covered by the card's own per-card test

nameCard.reason: Op "nameCard" suspends for a live card-name choice (CR 201.4) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

optionChoice.reason: Op "optionChoice" suspends on a live mode pick (CR 700.2) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

payVariableMana.reason: Op "payVariableMana" suspends for a variable mana-payment nomination — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

preventDamage.reason: Op "preventDamage" registers a dormant shield (no same-resolution damage event) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

putBack.reason: Op "putBack" suspends for a live hand pick (CR 401.4) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

randomExileToHand.reason: Op "randomExileToHand" picks a random card from a source-linked exile pile — the canned generator does not provision the pile; covered by the Op's interpreter tests

rangedTopdeck.reason: Op "rangedTopdeck" suspends for a live ranged hand pick (CR 119.4) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

recallCapturedBinding.reason: Op "recallCapturedBinding" spans two separate resolutions of the same source's abilities — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

redirectDamage.reason: Op "redirectDamage" registers a dormant shield (no same-resolution damage event) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

reflexiveTrigger.reason: Op "reflexiveTrigger" resolves on a separate stack object after a priority round — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

restrictCombat.reason: Op "restrictCombat" only manifests at a later combat step — covered by hand-written tests

returnExiledForSource.reason: Op "returnExiledForSource" only has an observable outcome after a prior exileWithAttachments armed a bundle — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

reveal.reason: Op "reveal" changes card visibility (knownTo) — not a state change the canned generator asserts

revealAndCategorize.reason: Op "revealAndCategorize" suspends for a categorized look-distribute pick — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

revealTopAndRoute.reason: Op "revealTopAndRoute" routes the revealed top card by its characteristics — the canned generator cannot provision a known top card; covered by the Op's interpreter tests

revealUntilMatch.reason: Op "revealUntilMatch" reveals a prefix whose size depends on the library composition — the canned generator cannot provision a known library; covered by the Op's interpreter tests

sacrifice.reason: Op "sacrifice" consumes a choice binding — covered by the card's own suspension/resume tests

scryReorder.reason: Op "scryReorder" suspends for a look/reorder-top choice — covered by the Op's interpreter tests and the card's suspension/resume tests

setBasePT.reason: Op "setBasePT" sets base P/T (CR 613.4b) — covered by the Op's own interpreter + wire-format tests

setCardTypes.reason: Op "setCardTypes" changes a permanent's card types (CR 205.1a) — covered by the Op's own interpreter + wire-format tests

setColor.reason: Op "setColor" is new — covered by the Op's own interpreter + wire-format tests

setIslandSanctuaryProtection.reason: Op "setIslandSanctuaryProtection" only manifests at a later declare-attackers step — covered by hand-written tests

setProtectionFromEverything.reason: Op "setProtectionFromEverything" sets a global player-scoped protection designation — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

setSubtype.reason: Op "setSubtype" is new — covered by the Op's own interpreter + wire-format tests

shuffleSelfIntoLibrary.reason: Op "shuffleSelfIntoLibrary" shuffles the resolving spell into a library (seeded-PRNG randomization) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

skipNextTurn.reason: Op "skipNextTurn" mutates a turn-boundary count, not a same-step outcome — covered by hand-written tests

transform.reason: Op "transform" swaps a permanent's printed characteristic set (front/back) — covered by the Op's interpreter tests

unattach.reason: Op "unattach" only has an observable outcome after a prior attach — covered by hand-written interpreter/card tests

winGame.reason: Op "winGame" sets state.gameOver — covered by the Op's own interpreter test
